dialogues.speaker: Vlaicu
dialogues.text: Heh, where do I even start... I've run into bandit and monster attacks, that sort of thing, when running intel at night... While things are generally manageable in the day, it can get really tricky on the road once it gets dark.

dialogues.speaker: Vlaicu
dialogues.text: And that's after accounting for the fact that someone as experienced as I am would already know the safest routes to take...

dialogues.speaker: Vlaicu
dialogues.text: But often, when there's absolutely no time to lose, we have to take the riskier option... In which case, it's entirely down to luck.
